newsitem.title: USA: IES 538 MW Iowa nuclear unit near full power.
newsitem.headline: IES 538 MW Iowa nuclear unit near full power.

text.p: IES Utilities said Wednesday its 538 megawatt (MW) Duane Arnold nuclear power station in Palo, Iowa, was again near full power after a recirculating pump cut out, forcing the unit to reduce output.
"As of 0617 (CDT), it was at 99 percent power," a company spokesman said.
The pump trip stemmed from a problem breaker that failed to close properly during testing.

IES Utilities, a subsidiary of IES Industries Inc, holds a 70 percent stake in Duane Arnold. Central Iowa Power Cooperative and Corn Belt Power Cooperative own 20 and 10 percent in the Palo, Iowa, plant.
